description: CI bundle size budgets for the Docusaurus documentation build. Thresholds are based on measured production asset sizes with headroom for intentional growth. Update deliberately when a feature requires a larger budget.
notes: Sizes are uncompressed on-disk bytes after `bun run build` (not gzip transfer size).
Total JS includes all code-split chunks; the main entry is checked separately as the critical-path budget.
Budgets refreshed after merging Dependabot bumps (lucide-react 1.x, docusaurus-search-local 0.55, cspell 10 toolchain) plus feature PRs that landed in the merge campaign.

The older `.performancebudget.json` values (300 KB JS / 50 KB CSS) are aspirational Lighthouse resource targets and are intentionally not used as hard CI gates here because they do not match current output.
